new_value: The lane-repair detection sweep did not run to completion, so whether a passing repair exists was never established. Covers unexpected detection abort (RPC / TypeError / firmware reload after clearing persisted repairs) before an unrepairable verdict. Distinct from TH-HBM-0006, which covers proven unrepairability (exhausted candidates, multi-bit / aword / DWORD LFSR unrepairable, or repairs that still fail verification).

name: MEZZANINE_CPLD_ACCESS_WRITE_FAILED
old_value: Mezz/eval CPLD register access or write failure
new_value: Mezz/eval CPLD register access or write failure.

name: PCIE_LINK_STATE_MISMATCH
old_value: PCIe link state mismatch (not L0 / Gen5 / x16)
new_value: PCIe link state mismatch: the Sohu endpoint link is not L0 / Gen5 / x16.

name: PCIE_AER_ERRORS_DETECTED
old_value: PCIe AER errors detected (correctable or uncorrectable)
new_value: PCIe AER errors detected (correctable or uncorrectable).

name: PCIE_CSRAM_DMA_THROUGHPUT_BELOW_THRESHOLD
new_value: PCIe->CSRAM DMA throughput below the qualified floor (suite-configured; 50 GB/s for the 1X module suite). Emitted by SohuDmaTestCase when its CentralSram throughput check fails in the active DMA flow.

name: PCIE_HBM_DMA_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH
new_value: PCIe->HBM DMA data integrity mismatch: dma_test_app read back data from an HBM region (EastHbm / WestHbm) that does not match the written random / bit-inverse pattern.

name: PCIE_HBM_DMA_THROUGHPUT_BELOW_THRESHOLD
new_value: PCIe->HBM DMA throughput below the qualified floor (suite-configured; 16 GB/s for the 1X module suite) on EastHbm / WestHbm transfers in dma_test_app.

name: PCIE_SPEED_CHANGE_FAILED
new_value: PCIe speed change failed (Gen5<->Gen1 transition did not complete).

old_value: PCIe lane margin below threshold (EH>25mV EW>0.2UI tentative)
new_value: PCIe lane margin below threshold (EH>25mV EW>0.2UI, tentative).

name: SOHU_ENDPOINT_NOT_ENUMERATED
old_value: Sohu endpoint not enumerated (absent from PCIe tree / RPC proxy)
new_value: Sohu endpoint not enumerated (absent from PCIe tree / RPC proxy).

name: VM_SENSOR_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE
old_value: VM sensor reading outside +/-5% of nominal
new_value: VM sensor reading outside +/-5% of nominal.

name: RAIL_ADJUST_READBACK_MISMATCH
old_value: Voltage rail adjustment not reflected in VM readback
new_value: Voltage rail adjustment not reflected in the VM readback.

name: VMIN_ABOVE_RATED_LIMIT
old_value: Vmin above rated limit for SA/SAU rail
new_value: Vmin above the rated limit for an SA/SAU rail.

name: UNEXPECTED_DVFS_RAMPDOWN
old_value: Unexpected DVFS rampdown event during workload
new_value: Unexpected DVFS rampdown event during a workload.

name: MODULE_POWER_ON_FAILURE
old_value: Module failed to power on (indicators off / rail fault or short)
new_value: Module failed to power on (indicators off, rail fault or short).

name: CHIP_ID_READ_OR_MISMATCH
old_value: Chip/module ID read failure or mismatch vs genealogy
new_value: The sohu_chip_id sysfs attribute of an enumerated Sohu endpoint could not be read or parsed, read back as all ones (device in reset), or reported a chip ID other than the one the resource configuration expects for that PCIe location.

name: SOHU_NOT_PINGABLE
old_value: Sohu not pingable / no response from firmware
new_value: The Sohu device did not respond to a ping over the RPC proxy: the firmware is not running, not reachable, or the device dropped off the proxy. Emitted when a device that had been posting stops answering, for example the post-campaign sweep after a repeated-FLR run.

name: PLDM_SENSOR_CHECK_FAILED
old_value: PLDM sensor discoverability or sanity check failed
new_value: PLDM sensor discoverability or sanity check failed (boot-phase gate).

name: I2C_PERIPHERAL_READ_FAIL
old_value: Mezzanine I2C transaction failed (controller bring-up, mux select, board-type read, or device probe)
new_value: An I2C transaction on the Sohu mezzanine failed. This covers bring-up (initializing the ASIC-debug mux or any of the four Sohu I2C controllers, and reading the mezzanine board type) as well as the per-device probes on I2C0-I2C3, where a probe either failed its transaction or returned data that did not match the expected device identifier/register value. The first failure ends the test; for a probe it identifies the bus, device, and address.

name: GPIO_LOOPBACK_MISMATCH
old_value: MCPU GPIO operation failed or read back the wrong value
new_value: An MCPU GPIO did not read back its driven value. Covers both halves of the test: the chip-ID strap pins reading a value other than the expected chip_id, and the per-pin output->input loopback failing to observe either the flipped value or the restored original.

name: UART_PING_LOG_MISMATCH
old_value: UART ping log message absent or content mismatch
new_value: UART ping log message absent or content mismatch.

name: JTAG_READBACK_MISMATCH
old_value: JTAG check failed (debug session could not be established, or a readback did not match)
new_value: A JTAG check did not produce the expected value, or could not be read at all: an ARC core cluster_id, the SA row/column build configuration, or a failure to select a core or read a register over the chain. The core1_cpu_reset read is recorded as a diagnostic measurement only and never fails the test. Failures before any JTAG transaction take the harness codes instead — an unknown jtag_interface is TH-HAR-0002, and no adapter matching serial_prefix or a missing OpenOCD binary are TH-HAR-0003.

name: EFUSE_REGION_READ_FAILURE
new_value: Reading the eFuse region over RPC failed, so no init config could be decoded from the module.

name: EFUSE_WS_FT_STATUS_INCOMPLETE
old_value: eFuse WS/FT / MBIST repair / SA repair status incomplete
new_value: The eFuse read succeeded but a wafer-sort or final-test completion flag (wafer_sort_complete, final_test_complete, mbist_complete, sa_complete, sensor_complete or hbm_complete) is False, so the module carries no record of a completed WS/FT flow including MBIST and SA repair.

name: BUS_CONNECTIVITY_CSR_ACCESS_FAIL
new_value: The mCPU-resident bus connectivity sweep reported a non-zero failed count: at least one CSR check across the SoC blocks (MCPU, ISC, IPU, CSRAM, WCU, GPIO, PAD, sensors hub, PCIe, SAMU, datalink, MACs) did not pass. A check fails either because a write/verify/restore readback did not return the written pattern, or because a read-only field did not hold its expected value.

name: SRAM_TEST_FAIL
old_value: On-chip SRAM test failure (stuck bits / readback mismatch)
new_value: On-chip SRAM test failure (stuck bits / readback mismatch) - the RPC read/write/invert checks reported failing SRAM regions, or the March C+ binary exited non-zero. Failing SRAM names go in the message / affected_instances, never into new codes (spec §1.2). Note - a non-zero March C+ exit is not yet distinguishable from a launch error; refine when the binary exposes an exit-status contract.

name: SA_MATMUL_NUMERIC_MISMATCH
old_value: SA matmul numeric mismatch vs reference (ULP!=0)
new_value: An SA matmul dispatcher test binary exited non-zero: systolic-array outputs did not match the funcsim reference. sa_sort screening tolerates a bounded number of defective SA columns, so a non-zero exit means the mismatches went beyond what the health map is allowed to mask out.

name: ATTENTION_SAU_NUMERIC_MISMATCH
new_value: An attention/SAU dispatcher test binary exited non-zero: one or more attention, KV-flush or SAU operations did not match the funcsim reference.

name: WEIGHT_LOAD_SPOT_CHECK_MISMATCH
new_value: Weight-load spot check failed: HBM-resident weights did not match the on-disk model after load (weight_load_test_app non-zero exit).

name: INFERENCE_DISPATCH_TIME_ABOVE_LIMIT
old_value: Sustained inference throughput on the million-token test did not reach 95% of the suite's expected_chip_tokens_per_second.
new_value: Sustained inference throughput on the million-token test did not reach the expected chip tokens/s (95% of the suite's expected_chip_tokens_per_second). Not wired yet: the check runs inside llama_mtt_app and the harness only sees the exit status, so a non-zero exit cannot be told apart from a model-creation or dataset failure. Emitting it needs the binary to signal the threshold failure distinctly, or the harness to parse MTT_results/metrics.txt.

name: END_TO_END_INFERENCE_NUMERIC_MISMATCH
old_value: End-to-end inference numeric mismatch vs reference
new_value: End-to-end inference numeric mismatch vs reference.

name: FLR_FAILED
old_value: FLR failed / flr_timeout_s 5.0s / recovery_timeout_s 10.0s / not pingable between FLRs
new_value: A Function Level Reset cycle did not complete cleanly: the reset request failed or went unanswered within flr_timeout_s (default 5.0s), or the device did not become available and pingable again within recovery_timeout_s (default 10.0s). Reported for the first failing iteration of the FLR campaign; per-iteration round-trip times are recorded as flr_round_trip_* measurements and are not compared against a limit.

name: SAU_PLL_CONFIG_FAIL
old_value: SAU/SA PLL configuration failure: firmware did not report a safe phase alignment after FLR, or a requested PLL glitch frequency did not read back within 5% of target before timeout.
new_value: SAU/SA PLL configuration failure - firmware did not report a safe SAU PLL phase alignment after FLR, or a requested PLL glitch frequency did not read back within 5% of the target before the readback timeout.

name: DEFECTIVE_SA_COLUMNS_EXCEED_LIMIT
old_value: Defective SA column count exceeds screening limit
new_value: Defective SA column count exceeds the screening limit. Retry is futile for a defect map.

name: CHIP_BIN_BELOW_THRESHOLD
old_value: Chip bin below acceptance threshold / failed binning criteria
new_value: Chip bin below the acceptance threshold / failed the binning criteria (e.g. unbinnable SA column mask count, or illegal bin transition).

name: PLL_GLITCH_FREQUENCY_READBACK_FAILED
old_value: PLL glitch frequency did not read back within 5% of target before timeout
new_value: RETIRED (ETCH-38346): historically emitted when PLL glitch frequency did not read back within 5% of the target before the timeout. New emissions use TH-SOHU-0020 (SAU_PLL_CONFIG_FAIL).

name: VFIO_PING_LATENCY_OUT_OF_SPEC
old_value: VFIO ping responses received but none within the allowed latency (device pingable, latency out of spec)
new_value: VFIO ping responses were received but none met the allowed latency - the device is pingable but its response latency is out of spec. Distinct from TH-SOHU-0002 (no response at all).

name: THERMAL_READING_OUT_OF_RANGE
old_value: Thermal diode temperature reading out of the qualified range, reported invalid by the sensor, or an uncalibrated mezzanine diode reading below 0 C.
new_value: Thermal diode temperature reading out of the qualified range, reported invalid by the sensor, or an uncalibrated mezzanine diode reading below 0 C (bad solder joint indicator). Failing channels go in the message / affected_instances, never into new codes (spec §1.2).

name: DTS_SENSOR_VARIATION_EXCEEDED
old_value: The peak-to-peak spread across usable Sohu DTS readings exceeded the configured deviation limit.
new_value: The peak-to-peak spread across the usable Sohu DTS readings exceeded the configured deviation limit (20C at L10). Zeroed and faulted sensors are excluded from the spread, so this reflects real sensor-to-sensor variation.

name: CTS_PROTECTION_NO_SHUTDOWN
old_value: CTS protection did not shut off chip at minimum threshold
new_value: The CTS trim code was driven to its maximum (lowest trip threshold) but the chip did not shut down: the CPLD cattrip latch bit in ASIC_CTRL1 was never set within the shutdown timeout.

name: CATASTROPHIC_TRIP_DURING_STRESS
old_value: Catastrophic trip event during stress workload
new_value: Catastrophic trip event during a stress workload.

new_value: DTS peak-to-peak deviation under power virus out of bounds (threshold under review; bounds may be raised).

old_value: Peak DTS temperature under power virus exceeds expected maximum
new_value: Peak DTS temperature under power virus exceeds the expected maximum.

new_value: The TMP464 thermal diode data could not be obtained - RPC/connection failure over the VBB UART, or a malformed response (missing temperature array, unexpected channel count). The thermal verdict is inconclusive.
